_meta.purpose: WARP_MANIFEST_V1 §10 conformance — measure where the server's URL resolver (urllib.parse.urljoin, used by warp._resolve) diverges from the WHATWG URL Standard that a browser applies when resolving asset URLs.
_meta.derived_from: web-platform-tests url/ (resources/urltestdata.json). Cases are hand-distilled to (base, input, expected_href) triples relevant to subresource URL resolution; they are NOT the verbatim upstream file.
_meta.coverage_note: expected_href is the WHATWG-resolved URL (spec ground truth). xfail=true marks a KNOWN divergence of urllib.parse.urljoin from that ground truth — the honest coverage gap. xfail=false cases MUST match or the resolver regressed. failure=true means the WHATWG parser rejects the input (no href).

cases.name: backslash_treated_as_slash_special_scheme
cases.divergence: For special schemes the WHATWG parser treats \ as /. urljoin keeps the backslash literal.

cases.name: tab_stripped_from_url
cases.note: CONFORMANT: modern CPython urlsplit removes ASCII tab/newline/CR from the URL before parsing (bpo-43882), matching the WHATWG pre-processing.

cases.name: leading_spaces_stripped
cases.note: CONFORMANT: modern CPython urlsplit strips leading/trailing C0-control and space, recovering the absolute URL as the WHATWG parser does.

cases.name: uppercase_host_lowercased
cases.divergence: The WHATWG host parser lowercases the host. urljoin preserves host case.
